arxiv.title: Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization via Zeroth-Order Residual Tracking
arxiv.abstract: Many optimization problems provide direct access to only part of the gradient, while the remaining component must be inferred from function evaluations. This structure arises in performative prediction, performative reinforcement learning, and bilevel optimization with a black-box lower level. We introduce Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization (PISO), which combines the available gradient component with a running estimate of the residual. By centring each zeroth-order observation on this estimate, PISO makes the variance due to random probing depend on the tracking error rather than the residual's magnitude. This yields a randomized sketch iteration with an explicit contraction mechanism and a principled interpretation of momentum. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish convergence guarantees that depend on the residual's variation and initial magnitude, without requiring a uniform bound on the unavailable gradient component. With independently sampled function evaluations and Gaussian or spherical probes, PISO attains leading function-evaluation complexities of \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-6})\) under Lipschitz gradients and \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-5})\) under an additional Lipschitz-Hessian assumption. These rates require only one probe direction, two function samples, and one known-component sample per update. The analysis also quantifies how batching trades observations for fewer deployments. Across five settings, PISO variants improve on the tested baselines with comparable oracle access in three, reach a comparable solution faster in bilevel routing, and perform best among methods without response-model derivatives in performative reinforcement learning.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过零阶残差跟踪的部分知情随机优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对只能获得部分梯度、其余分量需由函数评估推断的优化问题（表演式预测、表演式强化学习、下层黑箱的双层优化），PISO把已知梯度分量与残差在线估计结合，并用该估计中心化零阶观测，让探测方差取决于跟踪误差而非残差幅度，形成带显式收缩的随机sketch迭代。对光滑非凸目标，收敛保证无需不可得梯度的一致界；高斯或球面探针下函数评估复杂度为O(d²ε⁻⁶)，加Lipschitz-Hessian假设为O(d²ε⁻⁵)，每次更新仅需一个探针方向与两次函数采样。五个设置中三个优于基线，双层路由更快达到可比解。

arxiv.title: Inference-Time Steering Across Scaffolds and Epitopes for Sample-Efficient De Novo Nanobody Design
arxiv.abstract: Generative molecular design typically relies on over-generation and post-hoc filtering. Inference-time steering methods like Feynman-Kac (FK) steering improve efficiency by biasing trajectories toward high-reward candidates, yet they optimize within a single fixed configuration. In de novo nanobody design, upfront commitment to conditioning choices like scaffold identity or target epitope creates a bottleneck. Since yield varies across these conditions, steering unpromising setups wastes compute. We recast generative condition selection as an inference-time resource-allocation problem. We propose two dynamic budget allocators: a joint Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) formulation that steers and allocates compute across configurations concurrently, and a decoupled approach adapting Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE). Empirically, these dynamic allocators increase the yield of designable candidates per GPU-hour nearly 5$\times$ without sacrificing diversity across distinct therapeutic targets and generative configurations.
arxiv.titleZh: 跨骨架与表位的推理时引导:面向样本高效从头纳米抗体设计
arxiv.summaryZh: 从头设计纳米抗体通常靠过量生成再筛选，而 Feynman-Kac 等推理时引导方法只能在单一固定配置下优化——骨架身份或靶表位一旦预先选定，产量便受限于该配置，算力被浪费在无前景的设定上。该工作把生成条件选择重述为推理时的资源分配问题，提出两种动态预算分配器:跨配置同时引导并分配算力的联合全局 SMC，以及基于批式逐次消除(BaSE)的解耦方案。在多个治疗靶点与生成配置上，可设计候选的每 GPU 小时产量提升近 5 倍，且多样性未见下降。

arxiv.title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.

arxiv.titleZh: 回到开发状态：完整沙箱快照何时有助于编码智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码智能体常在取得部分进展后失败，而从零重试会丢弃失败前构建的机器状态。该工作把失败恢复建模为搜索问题，在 Daytona 完整沙箱快照上实现 Go-Explore 式搜索，允许恢复并分支中间环境状态。结果显示，更高的求解率与求解效率主要来自仓库之外的进展，例如数据库、服务与其他运行时状态；当长程编码任务跨越多个服务、其状态无法由单个 diff 重建时，全快照搜索收益最大。

arxiv.title: Studying Comics at Scale with Artificial Intelligence: The PAGE Framework and Three Studies of American Comics and Japanese Manga
arxiv.abstract: Comics are one of the great visual records of the twentieth century: hundreds of thousands of pages in which a mass readership saw its leaders, its wars and its heroes. Most of this record has never been studied as a whole; comics scholarship proceeds one book at a time. We argue that artificial intelligence, including generative models, can change this to the benefit of the medium itself. We propose PAGE, a framework that makes artificial intelligence an instrument for comics research. It parses every scan into panels, text and a bibliographic record; annotates each page with a vision-language model that follows a written codebook, as a human coder would; grounds samples of these readings in human annotation; and explains change across an archive, with estimates controlled for publisher and genre. We demonstrate the framework on 3,929 American comic books (1938--1956) and 87 volumes of Japanese manga, in three studies, each resting on a different capability. The first pairs text search with visual reading to recover how a mass medium portrayed political power. The second measures the page's visual form across an industry and recovers the hand of individual artists. The third follows who speaks across two comics traditions, checked against human annotation. Beyond research, the same instruments can make archives searchable by what is drawn, open comics to blind and low-vision readers, and help preserve fragile collections and credit uncredited artists. We outline a research agenda in which artificial intelligence strengthens the study, preservation and reach of the medium.
arxiv.titleZh: 用人工智能大规模研究漫画:PAGE 框架与三项关于美国漫画和日本漫画的研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 漫画档案体量庞大，学界长期逐本研读，难以整体把握。为此提出 PAGE 框架:把每页扫描解析为分格、文本与书目记录，用视觉语言模型按书面编码手册逐页标注，再以人工标注校准，并在控制出版社与体裁后解释档案层面的历时变化。在美国漫画 3929 册(1938–1956)与日本漫画 87 卷上完成三项研究，分别考察政治权力形象、页面视觉形式与个人画风的识别、以及对话归属，均与人工标注对照。该框架还可用于按画面内容检索档案、服务盲人与低视力读者以及保护藏品与署名。

arxiv.title: Specialists Learn Faster: Knowledge Organization in Pre-training Shapes Knowledge Update Efficiency
arxiv.abstract: An ideal (language) model must continually update its knowledge. Existing work largely focuses on making these updates efficient after training. We investigate how the organization of time-varying knowledge during pre-training shapes the efficiency of subsequent updates. Models trained on chronologically ordered knowledge specialize in the most recently encountered knowledge; we call them specialists. In contrast, models trained on the same knowledge in randomly shuffled order perform well across all represented time periods; we call them generalists. Surprisingly, specialists require far fewer update steps than generalists to acquire new knowledge. To explain this advantage, we derive a law from first principles that relates update cost to the model's optimization dynamics and that closely predicts empirical results. Guided by these findings, we design a strategy for organizing pre-training data that preserves stable historical knowledge while enabling efficient updates to current knowledge. We also show that the benefits of temporal knowledge organization extend to real-world pre-trained models and existing knowledge update tools, and generalize to other knowledge orderings. Project page: https://horizon-lab.org/specialist/
arxiv.comment: 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://horizon-lab.org/specialist/
arxiv.titleZh: 专家学得更快:预训练中的知识组织方式塑造知识更新效率
arxiv.summaryZh: 理想的模型需要持续更新知识，但已有工作多聚焦训练后的更新效率，忽略了预训练阶段知识组织方式的影响。研究发现，按时间顺序训练的模型会专精于最近接触的知识(称为「专家」)，而把同样知识打乱顺序训练的模型在各时段表现均衡(「通才」);意外的是，专家获取新知识所需的更新步数远少于通才。作者从第一性原理推导出将更新代价与模型优化动力学联系起来的规律，并能较准确预测实验结果，据此设计了既保留稳定历史知识、又能高效更新当前知识的预训练数据组织策略，并在真实预训练模型与现有知识更新工具上验证了该结论。
arxiv.reason: 预训练数据组织影响知识更新效率，含理论推导与策略，切入持续学习

arxiv.title: On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) promise to bring the benefits of continuous flow modelling to language, including accelerated sampling and controllable generation. The field has grown rapidly, and the capabilities of CDLMs have begun to rival those of discrete diffusion. Yet, unlike for continuous modalities such as images or videos, our grasp of the levers that matter when training CDLMs remains limited. In this work, we focus on two of these levers, namely self-conditioning and embedding geometry, and shed light on some of the mechanisms behind them, which in turn suggest cheaper and more effective designs. We begin by showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch by exposing the model to inference-like states that are otherwise rare during training. These gains can be recovered without an extra forward pass by a two-level interpolant, coined $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, which improves TinyGSM accuracy more than threefold. Self-conditioning also aids in recognising tokens dominated by large-norm Gaussians$\unicode{x2013}$an issue known as token identifiability. To address it directly, we introduce discrete reveals to $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, yielding $\mathrm{SemiCat}$, which achieves discrete diffusion-level performance on TinyGSM, reaching $49.94\%$ with standard training hyperparameters and a tuned sampler. At the $1.7$B scale, $\mathrm{SemiCat}$ outperforms discrete diffusion on four of six likelihood-based evaluations, and surpasses one-hot flows on unconditional generation. On embedded spaces, we find that cross-entropy drives embeddings towards a geometry whose decoding error rate closely matches the one-hot one. We briefly explore a range of further options, such as hybrid corruption processes and noise schedules, including asynchronous ones. We believe this exploration can help the community better understand and advance the design space of CDLMs.
arxiv.titleZh: 连续扩散语言模型的设计空间探析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对连续扩散语言模型(CDLM)训练中的两个关键设计变量——自条件(self-conditioning)与嵌入几何——展开系统分析。作者指出自条件的作用在于修正训练与推理之间的状态分布不匹配，并提出两级插值 DoubleCat，无需额外前向即可复现该收益，TinyGSM 准确率提升三倍以上;自条件还缓解大范数高斯主导导致的 token 可辨识性问题。为此在 DoubleCat 中加入 discrete reveals 得到 SemiCat,TinyGSM 达 49.94%，追平离散扩散;在 1.7B 规模下于六项似然评测中的四项超过离散扩散，无条件生成优于 one-hot flow。此外发现交叉熵会把嵌入推向解码错误率接近 one-hot 的几何，并初步探索混合腐蚀过程与异步噪声调度。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型属画像明确排除项，仅与 LLM 建模略沾边

arxiv.title: Can Language Models Learn When to Abstain? Policy Learning and Calibrated Answer Selection
arxiv.abstract: A useful language model should know when to answer and when to say "I don't know." Can we improve that decision by training the model itself or by training a separate component to check its answers? We study both approaches on Qwen3-14B for factual questions, using a score that rewards correct answers, penalizes mistakes, and allows abstention. Across three training seeds and two held-out confidence thresholds, a learned answer selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the original model's calibrated confidence filter. On TriviaQA, mean coverage increases from 20.2% to 30.9%, while the pooled error rate among scored answers decreases from 23.0% to 14.5% under exact-match grading. The tested reinforcement-learning changes do not establish consistent gains. On NQ-Open, the selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the filter but still performs worse than always abstaining. A partial human-reviewed audit preserves the TriviaQA finding. Our results support learning to select answers in this setting while showing that reliable abstention across datasets remains unresolved.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 语言模型能学会何时弃答吗?策略学习与校准的答案选择
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对模型该何时作答、何时回答「我不知道」的问题，在 Qwen3-14B 的事实问答上比较两条路线:直接训练模型本身(强化学习)与训练独立组件筛选答案，并以奖励正确、惩罚错误且允许弃答的效用分数评估。在三个训练种子与两个留出置信度阈值下，学习式答案选择器的阈值平均效用优于原模型经校准的置信度过滤:TriviaQA 上平均覆盖率由 20.2% 升至 30.9%，被计分答案的合并错误率由 23.0% 降至 14.5%(exact match)，部分人工复核保持该结论;但所试的 RL 改动未带来一致增益，且在 NQ-Open 上选择器虽优于过滤，仍不如全部弃答，说明跨数据集可靠弃答尚未解决。
arxiv.reason: 弃答与校准答案选择，属评测可靠性/后训练擦边，结果扎实但范围有限

arxiv.title: Shared Canonical Component Removal Beyond Expert Views
arxiv.abstract: In clinical practice, experts often begin by converting raw inputs into a set of expert features before making a decision. While black-box models trained on raw input can outperform models trained on expert views, it remains unclear what predictive signal the raw model exploits beyond what the expert view captures. We introduce an audit framework to quantify this gap using Shared Canonical Component Removal (SCCR). Unlike standard residualization or concept erasure, SCCR selectively removes only those directions strongly shared between learned raw and expert embeddings. Evaluations on synthetic data, coronary artery disease (CAD) detection, antidepressant treatment dropout prediction, and skin lesion classification using SkinCon annotations show that SCCR identifies the ways in which expert views are insufficient and recovers residual predictive signal while minimizing redundancy with the expert view.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越专家视图的共享规范成分移除
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床实践中专家通常先把原始输入转换为专家特征再作决策，而在原始输入上训练的黑箱模型往往更准，但原始模型究竟利用了哪些超出专家视图的预测信号并不清楚。为此提出审计框架 SCCR，它不同于常规残差化或概念擦除，只选择性移除学到的原始嵌入与专家嵌入之间强共享的方向。在合成数据、冠心病检测、抗抑郁治疗脱落预测以及使用 SkinCon 标注的皮肤病变分类上，SCCR 能定位专家视图的不足并恢复残余预测信号，同时把与专家视图的冗余降到最低。该框架可用于临床模型的信号审计与专家特征设计。
arxiv.reason: 临床医疗预测与特征审计，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: TabMF: Learning Dataset Representations with Tabular Foundation Models
arxiv.abstract: Representations of supervised datasets support higher-level machine-learning tasks such as dataset retrieval and distribution-shift monitoring. However, existing approaches typically rely either on hand-crafted meta-features or on dataset encoders trained specifically for representation learning. We introduce TabMF, a framework that repurposes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) as encoders of supervised datasets. TabMF equips a predictive TFM with an architecture-aware dataset-level readout and adapts the model end-to-end using contrastive post-training on stochastic views of synthetic supervised datasets. We instantiate TabMF on TabICLv2 and TabPFN-2.5 and evaluate the resulting representations across six tasks on unseen real datasets. Simple frozen TFM readouts yield competitive representations, indicating that predictive pretraining already induces substantial dataset-level structure. The two TabMF encoders obtain the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated learned and classical dataset representations, with particularly strong results in dataset retrieval, compact benchmark construction, and distribution-shift severity assessment.
arxiv.titleZh: TabMF:用表格基础模型学习数据集表示
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有数据集级表示多依赖手工元特征或专门训练的编码器，难以支撑数据集检索、分布漂移监测等上层任务。TabMF 将预训练表格基础模型(TFM)改造为监督数据集的编码器:为预测型 TFM 加装架构感知的数据集级读出层，并在合成监督数据集的随机视图上以对比式后训练端到端适配。在 TabICLv2 与 TabPFN-2.5 上实例化后，于未见真实数据集的六项任务上评测:冻结读出的简单方案已具竞争力，说明预测式预训练本身已蕴含数据集级结构;两个 TabMF 编码器在所学与经典表示中综合表现最佳，尤以数据集检索、紧凑 benchmark 构建与分布漂移严重度评估见长。
arxiv.reason: 表格基础模型的数据集级表示，选题有用但偏离 LLM 主线

arxiv.title: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
arxiv.abstract: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $β$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $β$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $κ$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.
arxiv.titleZh: 以精确高斯条件化统一扩散与流模型的后验采样
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散与流匹配模型常被用作线性逆问题的先验，但现有引导采样方法多只针对单一类轨迹先验，plug-and-play 方案又会隐式打散轨迹相关性，观测稀疏时先验过宽、性能下降。β-Flow 给出通用 plug-and-play 框架:相关参数 β 在流、扩散与去相关先验之间插值，置信度参数 κ 控制路径分布的约束强度，每步仅需一次去噪网络前向，再执行一次不依赖网络梯度的精确 Kalman 高斯条件化;许多已有引导采样器可视为其特例或近似。在 4 个数据集、7 类逆问题上 PSNR/SSIM 达到 SOTA，并显示观测信息量少时严格强相关先验更优、信息多时低相关更优，与贝叶斯推断中先验和似然的互补作用一致。
arxiv.reason: 扩散/流后验采样的逆问题求解，属低分方向

arxiv.title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), 2026
arxiv.titleZh: QTestBench：评估 LLM 生成量子代码的测试框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有量子编程 benchmark 只考察模型能否写出正确解，却无法判断模型生成的测试能否区分正确实现与错误实现；且量子程序具有概率性、依赖数值容差、由领域专用 checker 判定，形式合法的测试仍可能与基准结论相左。QTestBench 让模型分别生成语法、语义与行为三类测试，在运行时注入候选解，并在三种验证队列下把每个测试的判定与独立基准 checker 的标签逐一比对，不把测试本身当作真值。在 8 个 PennyLane QHack 与 10 个 Qiskit HumanEval 任务上评测五个 LLM，生成的测试几乎都能执行，但区分能力明显不足：最佳模型在 QHack 上测试质量 0.71、在 Qiskit HumanEval 上仅 0.34，说明可执行性会高估测试质量；当自然错误解稀缺时（十个 Qiskit 任务中有三个），经 oracle 校验的合成变异体可稳定缺陷检出估计。该框架为 LLM 生成量子测试的可信度提供了可复现的跨框架评测基准。
arxiv.reason: LLM 生成代码测试的评测方法，但落在量子编程这一偏门领域

arxiv.title: Tracing and Taming Hallucinated Terms via Subsequence-Association Filtering and Breadth-Aware Selection for LLM Query Expansion
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now a standard source of query expansion terms but they hallucinate. They inject non existent entities and off-topic terms that add ranking noise and can hurt strong retrievers. Existing remedies such as corpus grounding, mutual verification and preference alignment treat hallucinated terms as an undifferentiated nuisance to be filtered by agreement heuristics, without a mechanistic account of why a given term appears or a principled criterion for how many terms to keep. We propose Subsequence-Association Filtered, breadth-aware query expansion (SAFE-QE), a training-free, retriever agnostic method that draws on the subsequence-association account of hallucination. We score each candidate expansion term by its corpus conditioned cross-context reproducibility, terms that reappear under randomised query contexts yet lack support in the pseudo-relevant set are flagged as products of dominant hallucinatory associations and down-weighted. Drawing on the characterisation of language generation as a trade-off between consistency (no hallucination) and breadth (coverage), we cast term selection as constrained coverage maximisation over the pseudo-relevant set, keeping a set that is approximately broad but consistent and stable across resampling. We also introduce the Hallucinated Expansion Term Rate, a query side faithfulness metric that counts injected expansion terms no relevant document supports. We evaluate our approach on benchmarked TREC and BEIR collections. Our SAFE-QE is statistically indistinguishable from generative and corpus-steered expansion on nDCG@10 while injecting fewer unsupported terms 4.3 per query against 27.8 for Query2doc and 57.5 for HyDE and on a strong learned sparse retriever, where every expansion method regresses. Faithfulness is therefore available at no measurable cost in ranking quality.
arxiv.titleZh: 追踪与驯服幻觉词项:面向 LLM 查询扩展的子序列关联过滤与广度感知选择
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 查询扩展会注入不存在的实体与离题词项、给检索引入排序噪声的问题，提出免训练、与检索器无关的 SAFE-QE:基于子序列关联的幻觉解释，用语料条件下的跨上下文可复现性为候选扩展词打分，把在随机查询上下文下反复出现却缺乏伪相关集支持的词降权;再将词项选择建模为伪相关集上的约束覆盖最大化，兼顾一致性与广度并在重采样下保持稳定。同时提出 Hallucinated Expansion Term Rate 指标，统计无相关文档支持的注入词项。在 TREC 与 BEIR 上，nDCG@10 与生成式、语料引导式扩展无统计差异，而每查询不可支持词项由 Query2doc 的 27.8、HyDE 的 57.5 降至 4.3。

arxiv.title: Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR
arxiv.abstract: Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. Tone and palatalization are each signaled by a single acoustic property and occur least frequently in training (lowest training exposure), and text-based methods that flatten word frequency raise their frequency by 37--38%, reversing those errors while further improving aggregate error. The improvement from combining the methods exceeds the sum of their individual improvements; the superadditivity vanishes by 100 hours, limiting the complementarity to the low-resource regime. Where specific error types matter, we recommend selecting augmentation by training exposure and acoustic properties, both measurable before any training.
arxiv.comment: 5 pages
arxiv.titleZh: 错误率还不够:低资源 ASR 中数据增强的代价
arxiv.summaryZh: 低资源 ASR 的数据增强通常只用聚合错误率汇报收益，无法说明为何有效、何时有效。该工作在四种低资源语言与英语、五种数据规模上，把修改音频的 speed perturbation、SpecAugment 与修改文本再合成音频的两类方法交叉对比，并在音素层面做错误分析:SpecAugment 的聚合改进最稳定，却增加声调与腭化错误，文本类方法则引入辅音插入，二者组合可互相抵消对方引入的错误。文本方法拉平词频后使训练曝光最少的声调、腭化类错误频率上升 37–38%，组合收益超过各自收益之和，但该超加性在 100 小时数据后消失。结论是低资源场景可按训练曝光度与声学属性(训练前即可测量)选择增强方法。
arxiv.reason: 语音识别数据增强分析，属低分语音应用方向

arxiv.title: FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems
arxiv.abstract: Production recommender systems have feature-lifecycle asymmetry: adding new features must produce gains on some metric, while feature removal must not regress any metric. In practice, feature deprecation is hard to prioritize as a feature can fail to be removed if it interacts with other features, its importance changes daily, it cannot be evaluated before production models change or data drift occurs, it is in contention for A/B test space with other launches, it causes regressions in an online A/B test, or it is consumed by multiple models that need to coordinate its deprecation. We present FORTE, a model-agnostic production framework for discovering, validating, and removing features. Its efficient perturbation implementation allows daily feature evaluation. To account for interactions, it evaluates candidate feature sets constructed from all the low-rank features through grouped ablation and its offline results are sufficiently predictive of online A/B tests to allow deprecations to proceed to online testing with confidence. Lineage tracing identifies all downstream consumer models to realize the full savings of removing a feature from the training set. We validate FORTE over 2 large-scale recommender systems and find that it identifies deprecable feature sets which do not cause online regressions, while the impact on efficiency depends on model characteristics. On a search-relevance model, FORTE resulted in 3 nested candidate sets of 32, 48, and 59 features. Online guardrails rejected the largest treatment. The 48-feature set was selected for deprecation, removing 43.3% of the model's features. On a large ranking model, FORTE identified 8 candidates for removal. Retraining and A/B testing confirmed no regression. Its launch reduced the trainable parameters by 29.9%, improved serving throughput by 19.8-25.5%, and reduced annual training costs by hundreds of thousands of dollars.
arxiv.titleZh: FORTE:面向工业推荐系统的特征评估与下线生产框架

arxiv.title: REFLECT: Role-Aware Detection of Sentiment, Emotion, Politeness, and Formality
arxiv.abstract: Detecting communicative meaning in dialogue requires modeling not only lexical content but also the participant-role structures through which sentiment, emotion, politeness, and formality (SEPF) are expressed. Existing approaches rely on contextual language representations while leaving semantic roles implicit. We introduce a role-aware transformer architecture that maps the four SEPF dimensions to theory-grounded Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations, incorporating these configurations directly into the transformer's self-attention mechanism. Role-aware attention models non-directional internal states (sentiment and emotion), while directional role-aware attention captures initiator-to-recipient relations for external cues (politeness and formality). The resulting role-aware representations are fused with contextual embeddings through a learned gate that adaptively weights how much role information each input contributes, rather than appending semantic roles as an auxiliary feature vector. Across four benchmark datasets, the framework yields statistically reliable gains over strong BERT-based baselines for emotion, politeness, and formality, with gains concentrated in theoretically predicted cases such as low-frequency, complex emotions and highly polite expressions; sentiment improvements are marginal and non-significant, suggesting that sentiment is conveyed more through lexical choice than participant-role structure. Additional evaluation on real-world data demonstrates that the framework improves both predictive performance and model traceability. These results demonstrate that linguistically grounded modifications to transformer self-attention improve the detection of communicative meaning, generalize beyond benchmark datasets to real-world mental-health data, and yield traceable, role-grounded explanations that extend beyond predictive performance to interpretability.

arxiv.titleZh: REFLECT：角色感知的 Sentiment、Emotion、礼貌度与正式度检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 对话中情感、情绪、礼貌与正式度（SEPF）的表达依赖参与者角色结构，而现有模型仅靠上下文表示、把语义角色留作隐式。REFLECT 将四个 SEPF 维度映射到理论驱动的语义角色标注（SRL）配置，并把这些配置直接注入 Transformer 自注意力：非方向性角色注意力建模情感与情绪这类内部状态，方向性角色注意力捕捉礼貌与正式度的发起者—接收者关系，再通过可学习门控与上下文嵌入自适应融合。在四个基准数据集上，该方法在情绪、礼貌、正式度上相对 BERT 基线取得统计显著提升，增益集中在低频复杂情绪与高礼貌表达等理论预测场景；情感维度提升边际且不显著，真实心理健康数据上也验证了性能与可追溯性。

arxiv.title: Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between "just" and "only" is asymmetric: "only" units transfer selectively to exclusive "just", while all "just" units transfer to "only" equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation.
arxiv.titleZh: 不只是评估：语言模型对语篇助词敏感性的案例研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察 LLM 对英语语篇助词“just”与“only”的敏感性：这类词不改变真值条件语义，却影响语篇解读，此前少有研究。用行为实验与机制分析发现，模型与人类一样偏好上下文里出现这些助词，且对“just”比对“only”更敏感；从含或不含助词的上下文采样时，模型给出来源上下文的生成更高概率；指令微调会提升这种敏感性。最后定位到对助词敏感的单元，发现两者表征重叠并不对称：“only”单元可有选择地迁移到排他义的“just”，而“just”单元不论义项都能同样好地迁移到“only”，说明词汇层表征部分按义项组织。代码、义项标注对话刺激与人类偏好标注均已开源。
arxiv.reason: 语篇助词的语言学案例研究，机制分析有趣但偏离核心方向

arxiv.title: Randomized Momentum Transport with Cheap Predictors
arxiv.abstract: Momentum methods such as STORM and second-order momentum track the gradient by adding a transport correction to momentum, at the cost of an extra oracle call per iteration. We introduce randomized momentum transport, which evaluates the correction with probability $q$ and otherwise uses a cheap prediction, with importance weighting that preserves the conditional mean and adds $(q^{-1}-1)$ times the prediction loss to the variance. Under transport-bias, second-moment, and residual-control assumptions, linear minimization oracle (LMO) updates, including normalized, sign, and exact spectral (Muon) directions, retain an $O(T^{-1/3})$ stationarity bound for each fixed $q>0$ with a single-gradient initialization. For unnormalized STORM, some $q<1$ lowers the leading coefficient of our sufficient gradient budget if and only if the gradient-difference noise modulus exceeds the smoothness constant, by at most about $10\%$. An online diagonal predictor admits a regret-to-convergence guarantee. At approximately equal oracle cost, querying a quarter of the corrections lowers the final training loss by $18$ to $43\%$ on MNIST1D and raises the test accuracy of Hessian-vector transport on CIFAR-10 by $1.5$ points.
arxiv.titleZh: 随机动量传输与廉价预测器
arxiv.summaryZh: STORM 等动量方法靠传输校正跟踪梯度，但每步需额外一次 oracle 调用。本文提出随机动量传输：以概率 q 计算校正，其余步骤用廉价预测，并通过重要性加权保持条件均值，仅给方差增加 (q^{-1}-1) 倍预测损失。在传输偏差、二阶矩与残差控制假设下，归一化、sign 与精确谱（Muon）方向等 LMO 更新对任意固定 q>0 仍保持 O(T^{-1/3}) 稳态界；实验表明在近似相同 oracle 开销下，只查询四分之一的校正使 MNIST1D 最终训练损失降低 18%–43%，Hessian 向量传输在 CIFAR-10 上测试精度提升 1.5 个点。
arxiv.reason: 优化器与训练效率改进，方法扎实但非 LLM 主线

arxiv.title: Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing
arxiv.abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models (GDMs) corrupt the graph structure by adding noise independently to nodes and edges under a Markovian noise model. In the unconditional setting without node features, an equivariant denoiser trained on a single graph is able to generate novel graphs and sample-level metrics such as edge overlap and WL kernel similarity find no evidence of memorization. In this work, we challenge this view and show for the first time that graph diffusion models indeed exhibit memorization. Analyzing the reverse diffusion trajectories of GDMs trained on two-block stochastic block models (SBMs), we find a strong train-data bias: the model recovers a corrupted training graph almost perfectly compared to a held-out test graph. We term this conditional memorization, as it surfaces only when the reverse trajectory is conditioned on a corrupted training graph and is not apparent during inference. It coincides with a growing generalization gap, where the training loss improves as the loss on held-out graphs degrades, and it cannot be mitigated by early stopping. The onset of memorization always precedes the emergence of community structure in the generated graphs, thus every checkpoint earlier produces structureless graphs. This behavior holds across all node sizes we test.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop BeNTo: Beyond Next Token Prediction
arxiv.titleZh: 你的离散图扩散模型正在暗中记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 离散图扩散模型通过在马尔可夫噪声下独立扰动节点与边来破坏图结构，此前在无节点特征、单图训练的无条件设定中，等变去噪器被认为能生成新图，边重叠率与 WL 核相似度等样本级指标也未发现记忆迹象。该工作通过分析在两块随机块模型(SBM)上训练的 GDM 反向扩散轨迹，首次指出这类模型确实存在记忆:当反向轨迹以被破坏的训练图作为条件时，模型几乎完美地还原该图，而留出测试图则无法还原，作者称之为条件记忆，它在常规推理中并不显现。该现象伴随泛化差距持续扩大(训练损失下降而留出图损失上升)，早停无法缓解，且其出现时间总是早于生成图中社群结构的形成，早于此的检查点只能生成无结构图;该行为在所有测试节点规模上一致。
arxiv.reason: 图扩散模型的记忆与泛化分析，属扩散方向，与 LLM 主线无关

arxiv.title: UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes
arxiv.abstract: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.
arxiv.titleZh: UkrMeme:乌克兰迷因中的多模态可解释说服检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对乌克兰战时迷因中说服手法识别缺少数据与可解释分析的问题，构建 UkrMeme 数据集(200 条真实乌克兰战时迷因，逐条标注说服技巧)，并发布 PTM-UA——Propaganda 950 基准子集的乌克兰语译本，保留原始图像、仅翻译迷因文本。在零样本提示下按图像、文本与多模态三种输入评测视觉语言模型，采用层级 F1 指标;并对比层级相关性传播(LRP)与模型生成的 token 归因，分析两种解释方法所强调证据的语义类别。
arxiv.reason: 多模态垂直应用数据集，与架构/后训练/Agent 方向基本无关

arxiv.title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
arxiv.abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.
arxiv.comment: 11 pages (35 pages counting references and appendix), 6 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/Johnny-Liou/ReplaySSM
arxiv.titleZh: ReplaySSM:缓存 SSM 输入，而非状态
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 SSM 混合模型解码时每步读写固定大小循环状态带来的状态 I/O 瓶颈、投机解码缺少廉价回滚、状态量化误差沿循环累积这三个问题，ReplaySSM 将循环展开，用检查点加近期 SSM 输入缓冲区来表示状态，使输出计算与检查点更新解耦:多数步不写状态、只周期性更新检查点，状态内存流量约减半;近期输入缓冲区让投机回滚退化为指针移动，并支持只验证输出;低精度检查点负责多数步输出、高精度检查点负责循环更新，舍入误差不再进入后续更新。在 vLLM 中为 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet 实现，batch size 256 时较调优基线加速 1.20–1.47 倍，两个 120B 级模型吞吐约为 vLLM 投机解码的 1.8 倍。
arxiv.reason: SSM 推理系统优化，命中高效推理与投机解码方向

arxiv.title: DualQuant: Dual-scale Calibration-free Weight-and-Activation Quantization for LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.
arxiv.titleZh: DualQuant:面向LLM的双尺度免校准权重与激活量化
arxiv.summaryZh: 低比特推理要发挥原生4比特吞吐优势，必须同时量化权重与激活，而激活量化通常依赖校准数据。DualQuant将权重重建MSE最小化形式化为非可微问题，用变量分裂与块坐标下降求解，每个子问题有闭式解，并以权重重建得到的缩放因子直接作为逐通道激活缩放，实现免校准。方法统一支持MX系列与NVFP4等块格式，是首个正式支持MX与NV块格式的双尺度方法。在Llama与Qwen上于WikiText-2、C4及零样本任务中，其精度多数情况下匹配或超过基于校准的SmoothQuant，显著优于免校准基线;在RTX 4090上以真实打包W4A4路径验证，相比BF16可达2.61倍显存降低与2.46倍吞吐提升。
arxiv.reason: 免校准W4A4量化并支持MX/NVFP4，属高效推理硬核工作

arxiv.title: When Edge Independence Fails: Joint Graph Diffusion with Latent Sociability Priors
arxiv.abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models corrupt graph structure through independent edge updates with a Markovian noise model. Combined with the exchangeability requirement on the output distribution, the terminal prior is necessarily an Erdős--Rényi (E-R) random graph. This has a fundamental consequence for unconditional graph generation without node features: in the large graph limit, any GNN denoiser applied to an E-R graph approximately outputs an E-R graph, making effective denoising difficult. In practice, generated graphs fail to recover meaningful node heterogeneity and higher-order structure. Previous models introduced specialized node features to compensate, framing this as an expressivity problem, while the role of the prior remained unexamined. We instead address the root cause by introducing the Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) and a join} diffusion process that co-evolves latent node sociability variables and graph structure, removing edge independence while preserving exchangeability. Unlike existing latent graph diffusion methods, the sociability mechanism requires no complex encoder: its sole role is to guide edge updates and preserve node heterogeneity throughout the trajectory. We validate our approach on multiple graph generation datasets and show that the proposed framework more accurately captures graph distributions than baseline methods without node features.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 当边独立性失效:带潜在社交性先验的联合图扩散
arxiv.summaryZh: 离散图扩散模型通过边独立加噪，在交换性约束下终端先验必然是 Erdős–Rényi 随机图;大图极限下 GNN 去噪器作用于该分布几乎只能输出同类结构，生成图随之丢失节点异质性与高阶结构。为此提出潜在社交性先验(LSP)与联合扩散过程，让潜在节点社交性变量与图结构协同演化，在保留交换性的同时打破边独立性，且无需额外编码器，机制只负责引导边更新。在多个图生成数据集上，该框架比无节点特征的基线更准确地拟合图分布。
arxiv.reason: 图结构扩散生成，属扩散低分方向，与 LLM 无交集

arxiv.title: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
arxiv.abstract: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.

arxiv.titleZh: 面向 LLM 智能体训练的匹配上下文组策略优化

arxiv.title: Studying the Effects of Task Diversity Using Small Mathematical Worlds
arxiv.abstract: Basic mathematical tasks like modular addition have been a valuable tool for illuminating aspects of neural network behavior that are challenging to see in noisy, unverifiable, large-scale, real-world settings. These studies have typically focused on a single task. However, modern language models are exposed to a vast number of tasks despite being trained with a next-token prediction objective. In this work, we introduce two mathematical task ecosystems, IntWorld and PermWorld, built from distinct but related tasks on integers and permutations. Both are designed to simulate task diversity within a cohesive mathematical 'world' where tasks are distinct but related. Because the datasets are procedurally generated, we can precisely vary the number of tasks, allowing us to begin to disentangle the role of task variety from other factors in training. After describing the datasets, we provide some initial results obtained from these datasets which support the idea that increasing task diversity increases the richness of a model's internal representations.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 13 figures. Accepted for poster presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 MATH-AI Workshop
arxiv.titleZh: 用小规模数学世界研究任务多样性的影响
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对以往机制研究多局限于单一任务、难以刻画任务多样性作用的问题，构建了 IntWorld 与 PermWorld 两个任务生态，分别由整数与置换上彼此相关但不同的任务组成，模拟一个自洽数学世界内的任务多样性。由于数据完全程序化生成，任务数量可被精确调控，从而把任务种类这一因素与其它训练变量分离开来。初步结果显示，任务多样性越高，模型内部表征越丰富。该平台为可控地研究多任务训练与表征形成提供了实验土壤。

arxiv.title: A Privileged Teacher That Only Scores Cannot Search: Critique-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: On-policy self-distillation promises to replace the sparse outcome signal of verifiable-reward RL with dense token-level credit: a teacher conditioned on the reference solution scores the student's own rollout, and the resulting distributional shift is distilled back into the policy. We investigate whether this scoring signal actually contains corrective credit. Using gold error spans in student rollouts, we test the two signals consumed by self-distillation objectives, the full-distribution KL and the token log-ratio, for two properties: whether they localize errors and whether they push probability away from erroneous student tokens. They exhibit neither of these properties nor can they reliably distinguish correct from incorrect rollouts within the same problem. We argue that this failure is structural: locating an error in a reasoning trace is itself a search problem, while a scoring teacher is never explicitly asked to perform that search. The same model, with the same privileged information, localizes errors substantially better when allowed to generate a critique. This forms the motivation for \emph{critique-conditioned self-distillation}: first generate a critique of the current rollout, then condition the scoring teacher on that critique. The resulting signal localizes errors, is corrective within error spans, and shifts probability toward tokens that initiate backtracking such as ``Wait'', ``But'', and ``Actually''. We further show that the critique is useful both at test time, where resuming a wrong rollout with the critique in context converts math problems the model cannot solve by sampling, and in cold-start GRPO, where it provides an advantage signal on prompts for which verifiable rewards alone provide none.

arxiv.titleZh: 只会打分的特权教师无法搜索:面向推理的批判条件化在线策略自蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线策略自蒸馏用带参考解的条件教师为学生 rollout 打分，试图以稠密的 token 级信用替代可验证奖励 RL 的稀疏结果信号。用金标错误片段检验发现，其依赖的全分布 KL 与 token log-ratio 既不能定位错误、也不能把概率推离错误 token，无法可靠区分同一问题下的正确与错误 rollout;作者归因于结构性问题:定位错误本身是搜索任务，而只打分的教师从未被要求搜索。据此提出批判条件化自蒸馏——先生成对 rollout 的批判，再让打分教师以批判为条件，信号便能定位错误并把概率推向"Wait""Actually"等回溯 token;该批判在测试时可从错误轨迹恢复出采样解不出的数学题，也为冷启动 GRPO 在无奖励信号的 prompt 上提供优势。

arxiv.title: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.
arxiv.titleZh: SafeDiSTL：分解联合约束以实现安全多智能体强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 协同多智能体任务中，团队级约束只能给出整体违规代价，无法分辨哪些智能体的动作造成了违规。SafeDiSTL 以信号时序逻辑（STL）鲁棒度衡量回合级违规，通过运行最大值累加代价增量，并借助平滑的全回合鲁棒度与可微动力学计算动作敏感度，在同一决策时刻把每笔代价增量分摊给各智能体，同时计入延迟效应。在协同负载运输、连通导航与网络化交通控制任务中，安全成功率分别达到基线的 1.6–5.1 倍、提升 11.1%，交通吞吐量提升 50–68%，且不牺牲无约束策略的性能。

arxiv.title: Orthros: Phase-Aware Heterogeneous Attention for Efficient Transformers
arxiv.abstract: Efficient attention mechanisms, such as linear and sliding window attention, aim to reduce the computational complexity of Transformers from quadratic to linear. However, their degraded in-context recall often necessitates interleaving full attention layers, leaving the quadratic bottleneck unresolved in long-context processing. To address this, we introduce Orthros attention, which shifts the efficiency paradigm from structural allocation to phase-aware decoupling. As a unified module, it dynamically switches its computation pattern across different phases of sequence processing, enabling linear complexity prefilling and full attention decoding. Our design grants Orthros attention a lower asymptotic complexity compared to vanilla Transformers in prevalent long-context scenarios characterized by heavy prefilling and light decoding. Beyond theoretical formulation and complexity analysis, extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate Orthros's superiority across multiple dimensions. First, we validate its fundamental language modeling capabilities, demonstrating scalability across varying model sizes and strong competitiveness in comprehensive architectural comparisons. Second, Orthros exhibits exceptional conversion feasibility via a data-efficient Transformer-to-Orthros conversion, yielding performance that even surpasses the original Transformer. Finally, Orthros achieves a $21.9\times$ prefilling speedup over Transformers with end-to-end inference gains, while preserving long-context capabilities, as demonstrated by near-perfect 128K needle-in-a-haystack results and Transformer-level performance on real-world in-context recall tasks. Overall, these advantages in high performance, flexibility, and efficiency position Orthros as a promising candidate to succeed the Transformer in industrial applications.

arxiv.title: SeoulMMOD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Origin-Destination Flow Benchmark
arxiv.abstract: Origin-destination (OD) flow forecasting supports urban mobility decisions by predicting the volume and patterns of human movement across a city. Most existing public OD benchmarks provide only a partial view of citywide mobility, covering a single transport service or at most two modes. With partial mode coverage, observed demand changes are difficult to separate into shifts across transport modes and changes in total travel. We introduce SeoulMMOD, a large-scale public benchmark for citywide multimodal mobility in Seoul. SeoulMMOD provides three years of hourly OD flows estimating total mobility for 6 urban travel modes across 25 districts and 426 sub-districts, together with travel-time, travel-distance, calendar, rainfall, and point-of-interest (POI) signals. Using SeoulMMOD, we benchmark 14 forecasting baselines under a common protocol and analyse the effects of spatial scaling, joint versus mode-separate training, and cross-year generalization. Results show that several spatio-temporal models that work at district level do not scale to sub-district OD forecasting, and that naive joint multi-mode training does not consistently improve accuracy. Together, the dataset and benchmark establish a reproducible testbed for multi-mode, multi-year OD forecasting at the city scale.
arxiv.titleZh: SeoulMMOD:一个大规模多模态起讫点流量基准

arxiv.title: Amortized Counterfactual Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
arxiv.abstract: Counterfactual inference asks how an observed outcome might have differed under different circumstances, such as whether a patient would have recovered had they received a different treatment. Such questions arise whenever decisions depend on the outcomes of alternatives that were not observed. Answering counterfactual queries generally requires knowledge of the underlying causal structure, which is often unavailable in practice. A common approach is therefore to first estimate the causal graph from observational data and then perform counterfactual inference. However, errors in the estimated causal graph can propagate to downstream counterfactual predictions. To address this challenge, we introduce the Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP), an end-to-end approach that answers counterfactual queries directly from observational data without first estimating a causal graph. CFGNP uses Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to exploit the dual-graph structure by restricting cross-world message passing to corresponding factual--counterfactual variables. Across synthetic and image-based benchmarks, CFGNP achieves stronger predictive performance than existing approaches, including on the German Loan benchmark, where it reduces MSE from $4.51 \times 10^{-2}$ to $0.19 \times 10^{-2}$. Furthermore, on synthetic causal graphs, a model trained only on 10-node graphs maintains strong predictive performance on graphs with up to 30 nodes, without retraining.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于图神经网络的摊销反事实预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 反事实推断要在不同干预下预测未观测结果，通常需先估计因果图再做推断，而图估计误差会传播到下游预测。CFGNP 端到端直接从观测数据回答反事实查询，用图神经网络利用双图结构，把跨世界消息传递限制在对应的真实-反事实变量之间。在合成与图像基准上预测性能优于既有方法，德国贷款基准 MSE 从 4.51×10⁻² 降至 0.19×10⁻²；仅在 10 节点图上训练的模型可零重训泛化到最多 30 节点图。

arxiv.title: Enhancing Legal Reasoning in Pre-trained Language Models via Knowledge Graph-Guided Multi-Task Pre-training
arxiv.abstract: Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. We evaluate our approach across nine Transformer-based encoders and 324 experimental runs. On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.

arxiv.title: Machine Unlearning for Federated Socially Fair k-Means Clustering
arxiv.abstract: Federated clustering can support applications such as patient stratification across hospitals and customer segmentation across distributed financial datasets. Responsible AI calls for fair representation of demographic groups and support for data deletion, motivated in part by rights such as the GDPR's right to erasure. These goals interact: deleting records can change the balance between groups and alter the clustering of the remaining population. We study exact machine unlearning for federated socially fair $k$-means, whose objective is to minimize the largest group-average squared distance to the nearest center. Our approach keeps separate local summaries for each group, so summaries at unaffected institutions remain valid as global fairness weights change. For two groups, we prove an initialization approximation guarantee independent of client group proportions under ideal sampling, and we show that same-seed replay reproduces retraining exactly. Reuse pays off most when a whole client withdraws: across three datasets, replay is $35.8\times$ faster than retraining for the initialization-only model and remains $2.4\times$ and $1.7\times$ faster with one and two fair-refinement rounds, which improve worst-group cost. For individual record deletions, gains are modest (about $1.06\times$), and certifying cached assignments can cost more than it saves. These results map where exact unlearning can profitably reuse computation. Code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc.

arxiv.title: Towards Understanding the Training of GFlowNets: A Theoretical Perspective
arxiv.abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn policies that sample discrete objects in proportion to a positive reward. They are trained by minimizing balance objectives, whose exact satisfaction guarantees correct sampling. However, a comprehensive theory linking nonzero balance loss and approximate stationarity to sampling accuracy, especially under evolving sampling distributions and backward policies, is still lacking. To bridge this gap, we develop a unified theory for Flow Matching, Detailed Balance, and Trajectory Balance in this regime. We first bound terminal symmetric KL by the square root of the expected balance loss. Then, we show that approximate stationarity controls this distribution error up to a tangent-space residual measuring parameterization incompleteness. Finally, we establish finite-time convergence under fixed or controlled sampling and fixed, balance-trained, or separately updated backward policies. Under standard smoothness assumptions, with fixed or controlled sampling and a fixed or balance-trained backward policy, the expected loss is $O(\barε^2+T^{-1})$ and expected terminal symmetric KL is $O(\barε+T^{-1/2})$ under uniform coverage. For a separately updated backward policy, we characterize the sufficient update decay to approach the residual neighborhood and preserve these rates. These results connect balance objectives to sampling accuracy and clarify how parameterization, coverage, and moving components govern GFlowNet training.
arxiv.titleZh: 迈向理解 GFlowNet 的训练:一个理论视角
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对非零 balance loss 与采样精度之间缺乏统一理论、尤其在采样分布与反向策略不断变化时的空白，该工作为 Flow Matching、Detailed Balance 与 Trajectory Balance 建立了统一分析框架:先用期望 balance loss 的平方根界定终端对称 KL，再证明近似平稳性最多通过一个切空间残差(衡量参数化不完整程度)控制该分布误差，最后在固定或受控采样以及固定、balance 训练或单独更新的反向策略下给出有限时间收敛率。在标准光滑性假设与均匀覆盖下，期望损失为 O(ε̄²+T⁻¹)，期望终端对称 KL 为 O(ε̄+T^{-1/2});对单独更新的反向策略，给出了足以逼近残差邻域并保持该速率的更新衰减条件。该结果把 balance 目标与采样精度直接挂钩，阐明参数化、覆盖与动态组件如何共同支配 GFlowNet 训练。

arxiv.title: Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy
arxiv.abstract: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.

arxiv.titleZh: 自适应 DHiSparse：负载自适应 KV 层级上的投机解码

arxiv.title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
arxiv.abstract: The fast pace in which protocols, frameworks, and technologies are being proposed for LLM-based agents results in a complex scenario for anyone aiming to create state-of-the-art AI solutions. Without an assessment on how different protocols, frameworks, and libraries work together to compose an Agentic Web solution, developers and organizations face different challenges (e.g., skilling, governance, infrastructure) even before becoming part of the Agentic Web ecosystem. In this context, we propose a system for performing Agentic Web evaluations called MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework) and present a baseline assessment of Agentic Web technologies, including 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent implementation frameworks, against 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks. Results suggest that selecting a task-specific technology stack may result in gains of task completion rate, efficiency score, and social value stability scores; and reductions in verbosity and time to complete tasks. With the presented results, we expect to present a baseline in terms of metrics and results for this complex and fast evolving scenario for those aiming at designing, assessing, and developing multi-agent systems.
arxiv.titleZh: Agentic Web 技术栈的基线评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM Agent 领域协议、框架、库层出不穷、缺乏组合评估的问题，提出多智能体系统测试框架 MASTIF，并在 300 个 Mind2Web 任务上对 3 个 LLM、3 种协议与 4 个 Agent 实现框架做基线评测。结果显示按任务选择技术栈可提升任务完成率、效率分与社会价值稳定性，并降低冗长程度与完成时间。该工作为设计、评估与开发多智能体系统提供了可复用的指标与结果基线。

arxiv.title: Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph
arxiv.abstract: Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI 'hallucinations' and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. In this paper we aim to tackle this problem in the context of German Legal Code. Using structure-driven parsing to create a Knowledge Graph (KG) for the source document navigation and retrieval, we compare several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies and evaluate their effect on the accuracy of retrieved citations.

arxiv.titleZh: 通过结构驱动知识图谱实现法律推理的可验证检索
arxiv.summaryZh: 在医学、法律等可靠性敏感场景中，RAG 需将生成过程锚定到可解释文档以实现可验证性，但源文档数量与体量增大后，朴素检索会失效并漏掉关键法条上下文。该工作以德国法典为对象，用结构驱动解析构建知识图谱来导航与检索源文档，系统比较多种 KG 感知的分块与检索策略，以检索引用准确率作为评价指标。结果显示结构信息能改善引用检索质量，为高风险领域的可验证 RAG 提供可复用范式。

arxiv.title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
arxiv.abstract: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters. This process adds overhead that requires separate optimization of the calibrator and subsequent model selection. In this paper, we show that standard (post-hoc) calibrators can be trained end-to-end with the backbone via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation. This formulation eliminates the need for a separate calibration set or a dedicated calibration loss by jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration using cross-entropy, introducing only one additional hyperparameter: the calibrator learning rate. Although our framework supports calibrators ranging from temperature and matrix scaling to NN layers, our results show that using the final classification layer itself as the calibrator yields accurate, well-calibrated models with no additional parameters. Our approach outperforms SOTA calibrators with minimal added complexity, while also avoiding the multiplicative overhead of separate calibration components in settings such as multi-task learning.

arxiv.titleZh: 一次到位：联合学习准确且校准良好的神经网络
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经网络灵活通用，但置信度往往校准不佳。现有后处理校准依赖单独的校准集与额外校准参数，还需分别优化校准器并再做模型选择，带来额外开销。该工作把标准后处理校准器与骨干网络写成双层 Stackelberg 形式端到端联合训练，仅用交叉熵同时优化准确率与校准，只新增校准器学习率一个超参数。框架支持温度缩放、矩阵缩放乃至神经网络层作为校准器，实验显示直接以最后一层分类层充当校准器即可在零额外参数下得到准确且良好校准的模型，效果超过 SOTA 校准器，并避免多任务学习等场景中独立校准组件的成倍开销。
arxiv.reason: 通用网络校准的双层优化，与 LLM 评测可靠性仅间接相关

arxiv.title: Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient is Nearly Minimax-Optimal
arxiv.abstract: Standard Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms suffer from high estimation variance because they rely on Monte Carlo updates. While off-policy variance reduction mitigates this problem, establishing optimal sample complexity currently requires either restrictive assumptions, such as uniformly bounded importance weights, or impractical second-order operations. In this work, we introduce Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG), a unified theoretical framework that abstracts a class of first-order estimators that integrate recursive updates with defensive importance sampling, including known estimators such as PAGE-PG and STORM-PG. We prove that this algorithmic class achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence under weak gradient domination for general parametric policies. We establish this guarantee using purely first-order updates, with minimal assumptions and without gradient preconditioners. By extending state-of-the-art lower bounds to continuous parametric policies, we establish an $Ω(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity limit, confirming our framework is minimax-optimal up to logarithmic factors and horizon terms.
arxiv.titleZh: 方差缩减策略梯度近乎极小极大最优
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准策略梯度依赖蒙特卡洛更新，估计方差大;现有离策略方差缩减要达到最优样本复杂度，往往需要重要性权重一致有界等强假设或不切实际的二阶运算。LVR-PG 把递归更新与防御性重要性采样统一为一类一阶估计器框架，涵盖 PAGE-PG、STORM-PG 等已知方法，在弱梯度支配条件下证明 Õ(ε⁻²) 的末次迭代全局收敛，且全程只用一阶更新、无需梯度预条件子。作者还将已有下界推广到连续参数化策略，给出 Ω(ε⁻²) 的样本复杂度极限，表明该框架在忽略对数与 horizon 项后达到极小极大最优。

arxiv.title: Transformer-based In-Context Score Operator Learning for Diffusion Models
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion models typically learn the generative dynamics of a single target distribution or a family of distributions indexed by conditioning variables fixed during training. This limits their ability to adapt to a previously unseen distribution from only a small set of examples. We introduce an in-context solution operator learning framework for diffusion models, in which each target distribution is treated as a task drawn from a meta-distribution and is specified at inference time by an empirical context set. Our method learns an in-context score operator that maps the context samples, a noisy query point, and the diffusion time to the task-dependent score, enabling reverse-diffusion sampling on unseen tasks without retraining or parameter updates. A key observation is that the task-dependent score admits a Gaussian-kernel conditional-mean representation. Its empirical Nadaraya--Watson approximation can be represented exactly by a model in our constructed transformer class, providing a principled foundation for the proposed query-dependent attention architecture. The operator is trained through amortized denoising score matching across task distributions. We establish generalization-error bounds that quantify the effects of the context size, the numbers of training tasks and within-task samples, model complexity, and intrinsic and ambient dimensions. Numerically, we evaluate the method on a range of scientific and visual datasets, including Navier-Stokes, ERA5 climate data, QuickDraw sketches, and Food-101. The results show that the proposed method performs well on relatively simple task families, while its performance degrades as task complexity increases, thereby illustrating both the promise and the limitations of in-context learning for diffusion models.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于 Transformer 的扩散模型上下文分数算子学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对扩散模型通常只学习训练时固定的单一分布或条件分布族、难以仅凭少量样本适配未见分布的问题，该方法把每个目标分布视为从元分布中抽取的任务，并在推理时用经验上下文集合来指定该任务。模型学习一个上下文分数算子，将上下文样本、含噪查询点与扩散时间映射为任务相关分数，从而在未见任务上无需重训练或参数更新即可完成反向扩散采样;关键观察是任务相关分数可写成高斯核条件均值形式，其 Nadaraya–Watson 经验近似能被所构造的 Transformer 类精确表示，算子通过跨任务分布的摊销去噪分数匹配训练，并给出量化上下文规模、任务数、模型复杂度与维度影响的泛化误差界。在 Navier-Stokes、ERA5 气候数据、QuickDraw 与 Food-101 上的实验表明，较简单的任务族表现良好，任务复杂度上升时性能明显下降。
arxiv.reason: 核心是扩散生成建模，仅借 Transformer 上下文学习，属低分方向
